messages:
kevin.s: FYI — FinCo POC wants to use a third-party telemetry SDK (PulseSDK) to capture app telemetry for the pilot. They asked for security docs today: CAIQ/SIG responses, SOC2, DPA, vuln scan/pentest. Can eng-security run a quick vendor review? Need ETA + must-have asks.

maria.security: I can take lead. Quick checklist we need from vendor: CAIQ (or CAIQ-lite), SOC2 type II report (or SOC2 bridge), DPA & data flow diagram, recent pentest (90d), SBOM / SCA results, TLS + cipher config, key management details (KMS/HSM), retention & deletion policy, and support for ephemeral API keys / IP allowlist.

sam.sales-eng: FinCo is blocking on timeline — sales promissed pilot in 2 weeks. Is there a minimal set we can ask for to unblock POC (not full enterprise onboarding)?

maria.security: Minimal unblock set: 1) CAIQ-lite answers or high-level security questionnaire, 2) SOC2 (within last 12 months) or SOC2 summary, 3) statement on data types collected + retention TTL, 4) ephemeral API keys and ability to restrict by org. If vendor provides a short attestation + contact for full docs, we can allow limited-scope POC with mitigations.

lisa.procurement: I'll open the vendor record in the portal. Sam — please send vendor contact and contract cohort (is this SaaS with customers' PII?). Also need vendor legal entity for DPA.

sam.sales-eng: Vendor contact is pulse-ops@pulse-sdk.com (they've been slow). Data: telemetry includes request path, error traces, and hashed user identifiers — no raw payment data. FinCo still considers hashed ids sensitive.

maria.security: Hashing alone isn't enough if it's reversible or stable. For the POC ask Pulse to: 1) confirm hashes are one-way, 2) support client-side redaction or allow us to proxy/transform events, or 3) offer an on-prem / VPC ingest endpoint. Also we should require AES-256 TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest with key rotation.

vendor-checker-bot: Automated vendor scan result: PulseSDK — preliminary score 68/100. Missing: CAIQ doc, pentest, SBOM. Link: https://vendor-checker.internal/pulse-sdk (requires SSO).

kevin.s: If we do limited-scope POC, what controls do we enforce on our side? Could we route telemetry through a proxy that strips PII and rotates keys per session?

maria.security: Yes. Recommended mitigations for POC: - proxy ingestion (strip/transform PII) - short-lived API keys + per-org tokens - IP allowlist to vendor egress (if supported) - audit logging for all events sent - retention TTL of <=30 days for raw events during POC - legal: signed MSA addendum limiting data usage to pilot only.

sam.sales-eng: Can we get a CAIQ-lite template to send? I can email Pulse. Any preferred wording for the attestation?

maria.security: Use this snippet: "PulseSDK attests that for the FinCo pilot they will (a) not use or surface raw user content beyond service delivery, (b) store telemetry only for the agreed TTL, (c) provide ephemeral API keys and IP allowlist for FinCo, and (d) provide SOC2 summary and contact for full CAIQ within 5 business days." Paste that as an email ask.

lisa.procurement: I'll queue the DPA request as a conditioned requirement for production. For the pilot we'll accept a one-off Data Processing Addendum (short form) signed by Pulse ops. Please CC legal@redwood on the ask.

kevin.s: Any quick red flags that would kill the deal?

maria.security: Major red flags: vendor refuses SOC2/pentest, cannot provide ephemeral keys or any separation for FinCo, or insists on indefinite retention of telemetry. Also no answer on data export / deletion. Minor but important: closed-source native SDK with no SBOM or SCA artifacts — requires extra scrutiny.

sam.sales-eng: Understood. I'll send CAIQ-lite + attestation + limited-scope DPA request now. Pulse reply ETA? unknown.

vendor-checker-bot: Ticket created: VENDOR-2026 (PulseSDK) assigned to maria.security, priority = P2, due 2026-04-03.

maria.security: I'll validate replies and prepare a short risk memo for Sales (one pager). If Pulse supplies CAIQ + SOC2 + pentest, we can greenlight POC with the mitigations above. If not, we either require proxying or push pilot to internal stub.

kevin.s: Awesome — please keep us posted. FinCo deadline is end of next week. :thumbsup:

sam.sales-eng: Tagging @lisa.procurement and legal in the email thread now.

maria.security: Added checklist to the vendor record and linked the ticket. Closing loop when vendor responds.
_extra_note: This document is a synthesized Slack thread for vendor onboarding / vendor risk review coordination.
